# xg2g

> High-performance Enigma2/OpenWebIf proxy, physical tuner arbiter, and adaptive streaming gateway for DVB-S2/C/T2 broadcasts.

xg2g is a specialized media gateway designed to run in front of Linux-based DVB set-top boxes (Enigma2 / OpenWebIf). It exposes a clean REST and streaming API to client applications (iOS, Android, Android TV, WebUI), coordinates physical DVB tuner leases, eliminates tuner starvation and set-top box lockups, and transcodes or remuxes live MPEG-TS broadcasts into modern HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) and fragmented MP4 (fMP4) streams with zero-copy hardware acceleration.

- [Concurrency Manifest (ADR-006)](docs/ADR/006-Concurrency-Manifest.md): Concurrency hierarchy, mutex ordering, and goroutine leak prevention across media pipelines.
- [Lease Arbitration & Reconciliation (ADR-029)](docs/ADR/029-resource-arbitration-composite-lease-model.md): Multi-resource composite tuner lease model, state machine, and conflict resolution.
- [Lease Reconciliation & Startup Gate (ADR-030)](docs/ADR/030-lease-reconciliation.md): 3-phase reconciliation engine (Snapshot, Deterministic Analysis, Bounded Remediation) and startup gates.
- [Lease Reason Code Matrix](docs/ADR/lease_reason_matrix.md): Exhaustive audited reason code catalog for lease state transitions, preemptions, and rejections.
- [Resource Conflict Policy Engine (ADR-031)](docs/ADR/031-resource-conflict-policy-engine.md): Dynamic tuner priority, client preemption, and graceful downgrade rules.
- [Device Identity Convergence (ADR-032)](docs/ADR/032-device-identity-convergence.md): Cryptographically bound client identity and device enrollment sessions.
- [Global Health Death Line (ADR-007)](docs/ADR/007-Global-Health-Death-Line.md): Fail-closed operational health gates and circuit breakers.

## Media Pipeline & Codec Matrix

- [Codec & Transcoding Matrix](docs/arch/CODEC_MATRIX.md): Hardware acceleration (Intel VAAPI, NVIDIA NVENC, Apple Silicon VideoToolbox), transcode fallbacks, and copy-mode heuristics.
- [Native WebKit HLS HEVC Passthrough (ADR-026)](docs/ADR/026-native-webkit-hls-hevc-copy.md): Zero-transcode HEVC remuxing for Apple Safari and native iOS AVPlayer pipelines.
- [Playback Capability Claims (ADR-028)](docs/ADR/028-playback-capability-claims.md): Client-advertised decoding capabilities and automatic server-side profile matching.
